mood: 우드 클로즈업 샷: one quiet close pair on pale live-edge wood under a single broad diffuse window

reference_cluster.selection_rule: the user-approved close 4:5 wood reference is the sole geometric, support, light, screen-color and tone anchor

key_light.source: one very large diffused upper-left rear window
key_light.direction: upper-left and slightly behind toward lower-right
key_light.relative_size: broad low-contrast source spanning both cups, table and sill without direct sun

ambient_fill: quiet neutral room and pale-sill bounce opens paper, ice and wood without flattening contacts

reference_anchor.role: offline camera, pair geometry, pale-wood, diffused-light and restrained-tone evidence; only the sanitized scene hint may carry low-frequency relationships

fill_contract.source: broad white sill, pale table, quiet occupied-room bounce and low-frequency off-frame occlusion
fill_contract.color_bias: neutral gray room return outside the wood surface, never blue or amber

screen_light_map.falloff: broad source rolls from upper-left rear across both cups into soft lower-right contacts, with faint low-frequency room-presence modulation outside the products
screen_light_map.gobo_geometry: no readable gobo; allow only very faint amorphous off-frame occupancy modulation, never a plant, person, mullion or object silhouette

specular_contract.highlight_shape: broad interrupted transparent edges, rolled paper white, tiny irregular ice responses and sparse condensation sparkle
specular_contract.rim_continuity: readable but naturally interrupted by viewing angle, paper fibers, ice and condensation
specular_contract.transparent_caustic: subtle, local and bounded to real transparent paths

camera_coupling.support_plane: 52-58mm view at 90-120cm and 20-25 degrees above one round pale live-edge table
camera_coupling.shadow_projection: both contacts share a 118-150 degree lower-right direction and broad penumbrae
camera_coupling.depth_response: measured overlap, relative scale, table ellipse and tonal falloff establish depth before softness

color_separation.lit_neutral: 4850-5100K subdued warm-neutral daylight below clipping, matched to the 4:5 reference screen color
color_separation.shadow_neutral: neutral brown-gray with cool exterior influence
color_separation.material_locality: warm beige-brown remains local to wood; paper stays neutral; exterior stays cool gray; user beverage keeps source color

shadow_contract.edge: broad soft environmental penumbra with denser compact contacts and faint non-descriptive room modulation
shadow_contract.attachment: each drink base intersects the same wood plane with no floating gap or pasted halo
shadow_contract.transparent_material: bounded drink-colored transmission only where the exact user product is physically transparent

contact_shadow.behavior: small dense attached ellipses directly under both cup bases and a tiny distant contact under the sill pot

cast_shadow.behavior: short overlapping 118-150 degree lower-right shadows with broad soft edges integrated into low-frequency room bounce

transmitted_light.behavior: subtle bounded lift inside physically transparent product paths only

capture_contract.hdr: restrained single-exposure response with protected paper, sill and transparent highlights
capture_contract.white_balance: 4850-5100K subdued warm-neutral daylight matched to Image 2 with source-authoritative product color
capture_contract.texture: finite natural acuity, matte wood pores, paper fibers, irregular ice, crema bubbles and nonuniform condensation; never uniformly crisp
